title.narrative: Vocational skills development for young girls

description.narrative: Project Title: Stitching the Future: Vocational Skills Development for Young Girls in Kakonko District - Kigoma through Sewing and Tailoring. Goal: To empower young girls in Kakonko District - Kigoma with vocational skills in sewing and tailoring to improve their socio-economic well-being. This project aims to break that cycle by equipping marginalized girls in Kigoma (Kakonko District) with practical, market-relevant vocational skills—particularly in sewing and tailoring—to foster self-employment and financial independence. By providing inclusive and targeted training, coupled with mentorship and access to markets, the initiative empowers young women to build sustainable livelihoods.
